newsitem.title: INDIA: ING Barings overweight on Indian state-run firms.
newsitem.headline: ING Barings overweight on Indian state-run firms.

text.p: Securities firm ING Barings said on Wednesday Indian stock markets have not yet discounted bad news on the political, economic and corporate fronts.
"We believe the market is going to form a long-term bottom as it recognises recessionary trends and evaporating corporate earnings growth," ING Barings said in its November report on India.
The report advised investors to restructure their portfolios to overweight shares of state-run firms and underweight private sector businesses.
"On the sectoral front we recommend investors to BUY oil, refineries, telecom, banks, utilities and petrochemicals and SELL automobiles, cement and steel companies," it said.
